fields.title: Aramid installed strength
fields.finding: 3GPa is conditioned yarn;95%retention,100%film efficiency and inherited thermal factor are optimistic assumptions.60%efficiency loses most favourable-weather closure.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure balanced membrane strength, creep, thermal mismatch, seams and long-term humid-service retention.
